exclusions.name: drop-health-probes
exclusions.description: GKE/Cloud Run readiness, liveness and healthz probes (noise, no diagnostic value).
exclusions.filter: (httpRequest.requestUrl=~"/healthz|/readyz|/livez|/health$" OR textPayload=~"readiness probe|liveness probe" OR jsonPayload.message=~"probe") AND NOT logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com"

exclusions.name: drop-debug-in-prod
exclusions.description: Drop DEBUG and lower severity in prod environment (should never ship but we defend-in-depth).
exclusions.filter: severity<INFO AND resource.labels.environment="prod" AND NOT logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com"

exclusions.name: drop-vpc-flow-internal
exclusions.description: VPC Flow Logs for intra-subnet traffic between known health-check source ranges.
exclusions.filter: resource.type="gce_subnetwork" AND logName=~"compute.googleapis.com%2Fvpc_flows" AND (jsonPayload.src_vpc.vpc_name="prod-vpc" AND jsonPayload.dest_vpc.vpc_name="prod-vpc") AND NOT logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com"

exclusions.name: drop-successful-gcs-reads
exclusions.description: Drop 2xx GCS object reads from the public assets bucket (noisy, no security value).
exclusions.filter: resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND resource.labels.bucket_name="PROJECT_ID-public-assets" AND httpRequest.status<300 AND NOT logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com"
